recommended_approach: Constraint-Based Glass Shattering: pre-fracture the window into rigid-body shards, then connect adjacent shards with breakable FIXED rigid body constraints so the brick impact progressively releases fragments instead of dropping the whole pane at once.

key_parameters.breaking_threshold: Set to the shard-link force level you want the brick impact to exceed; this controls when connected glass pieces separate.

warnings: Do not default to the simplest destruction setup; choose the technique based on scene realism needs.
Basic pre-fracture alone can make all shards fall at once instead of producing progressive shatter.
Projectile setup can fail so the brick does not hit the pane correctly.
Rigid body settings can become unstable, causing shard jitter.
A pure rigid-body breakup can look too clean without smaller secondary debris.
alternative_approaches: Cell Fracture + Rigid Body prefracture workflow.
Rigid-body glass shards plus particle debris for smaller glass chips and secondary fragments.
